drbg_mode.title: DRBG mode

actions.message: DRBG-CTR is recommended with hardware acceleration for vulnerability reasons. It enables AES and SHA-256 or SHA-512.
Please enable DRBG-HMAC as an alternative mode. It enables SHA-256 or SHA-512.
For security reasons, AES implementation = HAL or DRBG-HMAC are recommended.
For security reasons, DRBG-CTR is recommended.

oneOf.title: DRBG - HMAC
oneOf.description: Mbed TLS Alternative STM32 Cryptographic library.

drbg_mode.description:
The implementation selection determines the cryptographic module used.
 If the MbedTLS alternative hardware abstraction layer (HAL) is selected, the deterministic random bit generator using counter mode (DRBG-CTR) is preferred.
 DRBG-CTR is recommended for security reasons. It enables the use of AES and SHA-256.
